content:
![Pastek's Lucky Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28629cc286efdefc73aa361a3cf168444e587ca8.png)

_一款经典的幸运方块模组，包含陷阱、糟糕和丰厚的战利品，为你的游戏增添乐趣。你可以使用八个金锭和石英或一片西瓜合成这些幸运方块，也可以在世界中找到它们，只需破坏它们即可在你的生存游戏中进行赌博冒险。_

![Swamp Lucky Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3feebf8f8cf3b4c6345242d7838fbcab3e3942e1_0.webp)

**此模组与以下模组默认兼容：**
- Create
- Corail Tombstone
- Alex's Mobs
- Aquamirae
- L_Ender's Cataclysm
- Cold Sweat
- Farmer's Delight
- Eureka! Ships!
- Artifacts
- Relics
- Immersive Engineering
- Electrodynamics
- Nuclear Science
- Chemical Science
- Modular Force Fields
- Ballistix
- Assembly Line
- Cobblemon
- Alex's Caves
- Dungeons and Taverns
- Moog's Voyager Structures
- Ad Astra
- Per Spatium
- When Dungeons Arise
- When Dungeons Arise - Seven Seas
- Repurposed Structures
- Towns And Towers

如需帮助添加自定义模组兼容性或配置模组，请访问 [CurseForge 模组页面](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pasteks-lucky-block)。

英语和法语翻译

当然，你可以自由地在你的模组包中使用此模组，无需署名或其他要求。
